meta.description: Navigate Amazon as buyer, seller, or affiliate with price tracking, listing optimization, and smart purchasing decisions.

copy.tagline: 追踪亚马逊商品价格、优化商品信息、做出更明智的购买决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在亚马逊上购物、卖货或做推广
copy.tagline_en: Track Amazon prices, optimize listings, and make smarter purchase decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you buy, sell, or promote on Amazon

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理亚马逊上的购买、销售和联盟营销任务，例如搜索商品、追踪价格、优化商品列表、生成联盟链接等。
howto.when: 当你提出与亚马逊相关的请求时触发，如搜索商品、比较价格、重新订购、检查折扣、比较产品或请求销售、联盟链接帮助。

say.text: 帮我找售价50美元以内最好的蓝牙耳机。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并比较评论、评分和价格历史。

say.text: 追踪这款洗衣液的价格。
say.note: Claude 会监控价格并提醒降价。

say.text: 生成这个商品的联盟链接。
say.note: Claude 会创建带标签的联盟链接。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can assist with Amazon tasks for buyers, sellers, and affiliates: product search, price tracking, listing optimization, affiliate link generation, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Amazon-related help: finding products, comparing prices, reordering, checking deals, comparing products, selling help, or generating affiliate links.

say_en.text: Find the best Bluetooth earphones under $50.
say_en.note: Claude searches and compares reviews, ratings, and price history.

say_en.text: Track the price of this laundry detergent.
say_en.note: Claude monitors and alerts on price drops.

say_en.text: Generate an affiliate link for this product.
say_en.note: Claude creates a tagged affiliate link.
